fetch_pe_checkpoint: fetch a PE vision encoder checkpoint from HuggingFace Hub by model name or local path
create_PEConfig: create a PEConfig dataclass instance to define vision tower architecture parameters like patch size and layers
create_PETextConfig: create a PETextConfig dataclass instance to define text tower architecture parameters like context length and width
lookup_PE_VISION_CONFIG: lookup a pre-defined PE vision encoder config by name such as PE-Core-G14-448 or PE-Spatial-L14-448
lookup_PE_TEXT_CONFIG: lookup a pre-defined PE text encoder config by name such as PE-Core-G14-448 or PE-Core-B16-224
